claim_boundary: This locks the literature-exact angular-independent cubic Gaussian WDA as a Route-2 V0 common-scalar control. It is not a physical solvent asset, total solvation calculation, chemistry score, force/PES result, or accuracy claim.

literature.title: Accurate prediction of hydration free energies and solvation structures using molecular density functional theory with a simple bridge functional
literature.scope: The paper's water-model/same-force-field simulation comparisons motivate the functional form only. They do not certify Route-2 experimental accuracy, solvent transferability, or the immutable maximum-error gates.

construction.name: molecular-cubic-wda-2021
construction.centre_projection: rho = D nu, with D nu_bulk = rho_bulk and dv <q, D d> = sum_i w_i (D^T q)_i d_i
construction.bridge_scalar: F_B^cWDA = kBT rho_bulk dv sum_g a_s[((K_sigma D nu)_g-rho_bulk)/rho_bulk]^3 = dv sum_g A_s(rho_bar-rho_bulk)^3
construction.gaussian_kernel: K_sigma(r) = (2 pi sigma_s^2)^(-3/2) exp[-|r|^2/(2 sigma_s^2)]; the periodic grid implementation must use the declared positive periodic Gaussian image sum, exact dv normalization, and periodic-even adjoint.
construction.pressure_cross_check: A_s = (P_HNC-P_s)/rho_bulk^3 = (rho_bulk kBT a_s-P_s)/rho_bulk^3. Any mismatch between the frozen molecular-HNC zero mode and chi_T fails closed.
construction.surface_tension_constraint: sigma_s is frozen only by a stationary pure-liquid planar-interface calculation against an independently sourced gamma_s; neither sigma_s nor K_sigma can be selected from a solute cavity or solvation error.
construction.response_rule: Use exact D^T K_sigma derivatives and the same-scalar Hessian; no response symmetrization, clipping, or damping is a model term.

required_before_target_solute_execution: one exact all-atom solvent model and source digest
the exact source-provenanced finite-wavevector and orientational liquid correlation used by the HNC scalar
independent pure-liquid pressure, isothermal compressibility, and liquid-gas surface tension bound to that exact model
a stationary planar-interface determination of the Gaussian width, with residual and grid-refinement evidence
content digests for the centre projection, Gaussian kernel, liquid sources, and source-bound cubic-WDA certificate
a complete MACE-native solute-solvent external potential, standard-state ledger, force terms, and Cartesian/orientation convergence evidence
physical_admission_contract.direct_constructor_status: synthetic-or-source-control-only; it cannot establish physical-liquid admission or an accuracy result
forbidden_inputs: development, confirmation, or blind solvation values
target-solute cavity radii or solvation errors

electrostatic_bridge_boundary.reason: The cited paper's separate solute-water electrostatic bridge is a distinct solute-density-coupled functional term calibrated to a pure-water excess chemical potential and reported to have ionic limitations. It requires its own source-bound excess-chemical-potential, charged-solute, and multi-solvent falsification contract before V0 can use it.

validation_sequence: Verify the Gaussian kernel's discrete normalization, periodic inversion symmetry, convolution self-adjointness, and content digest.
Verify the pure-liquid compressibility zero mode, dimensionless cubic coefficient, molecular-HNC pressure, and cubic coefficient cross identity.
Verify scalar energy, gradient, Hessian-vector action, Hessian reciprocity, and scalar second derivative by finite differences before physical admission.
Verify a source-bound physical pure-liquid certificate with stationary planar gamma and grid/orientation convergence before target-solute execution.
Verify stationary liquid forces, standard state, and the complete pre-registered solvent panel before chemistry scoring.
Run the immutable route2-v0-historical-freesolv10-regression-v1 panel, including ethyl acetate, and require every error strictly below 1.5 kcal/mol before any V0 pass claim.
Then run the 11-solvent development, disjoint confirmation, and external blind maximum-error gates without changing the liquid functional, Gaussian width, or source assets.
decision_rule: Any source, zero-mode, Gaussian-kernel, stationary-interface, scalar, force, historical-panel, multi-solvent, confirmation, or blind failure rejects the frozen candidate. It does not authorize a pressure correction, response patch, solvation-label regression, post-training, fine-tuning, or per-record method selection.
